# challenger_candidate_evaluation

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Evaluates a challenger on a fixed episode set and preserves a refusal outcome.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `evaluation_id` | `string` | yes | Stable challenger evaluation identity. |
| `challenger_policy_id` | `string` | yes | Challenger policy under evaluation. |
| `episode_set_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of the immutable evaluation episode set. |
| `evaluation_seed` | `string` | yes | Explicit evaluation seed. |
| `score` | `float` | yes | Observed challenger score. |
| `refusal_code` | `string` | yes | Typed refusal or admitted result. |
